output_specification.negative_prompt: do not render JSON keys, field names, hex codes, pixel values, font name literals, COLOR NAMES as visible text. ABSOLUTELY ZERO CITATION OR REFERENCE MARKERS — no [cite:1], [cite_start], [1], [^1], (1), ^1, 'Source:', 'Ref:', no bracketed numbers, no URLs as visible text. ABSOLUTELY NO rotation/angle markings as visible text. ABSOLUTELY NO acronyms — write 'U.S.' as literal characters only. The mascot's face must NEVER be illustrated, painted, drawn, AI-generated, 3D Memoji, chibi, anime, or cartoon — it is ALWAYS a literal real photograph cut-out of Alex Karp's actual face. Mascot body is natural cartoon-Funko-Pop proportions. Mascot pose must be a CLEAR FULL-BODY STAR / SPREAD-EAGLE POSE — both arms raised diagonally up and out, both legs spread diagonally down and out, forming the shape of a star or the Chinese character 大. NO Unicode emoji as visible text. NO gradient backgrounds. NO drop shadows on text. NO Korean/Chinese/Japanese characters as visible text — the 大 shape is conveyed by the mascot's BODY POSE only, never by drawing the literal character. NO page counter. NO notebook spring/pencil/binder clip — corkboard only. NO polaroid photo frames around the mascot. NO FREE PDF stamp. NO promise bullet card. NO delivery note. NO 'NEW INSIGHTS EVERY WEEK' badge. NO 'MORE!' speech bubble. NO bottom-center @broisinvesting footer — the masthead at the very top is the ONLY @broisinvesting on the slide.
